meta.name: Triangle Of Venus, Die Insel Der Tausend Freuden 1978
meta.description:
A wealthy matriarch keeps a close eye on the complicated and often erotic lives of her children and relatives.
Not sure about the plot here, presumably there was a script but it is mostly an excuse to get a lot of good looking people naked. Of course, if you noticed it was directed by Hubert Frank, you already knew that. English dubbed version.
